reader_question: How has the number of applications to start a business changed since 2005?
grade_line: Documented: a Census Bureau count of applications for a tax ID
title: Americans filed 5.7 million applications to start a business in 2025, more than twice the 2.5 million of 2005.
measure_line: Applications for a federal tax ID that signal a new business, in millions, each year from 2005, the first full year the Census Bureau publishes, to 2025, United States
source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Business Formation Statistics, September 2026 monthly release (October 14, 2026), business applications, 2005 to 2025, 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Applications for a tax ID that signal a new business; many never hire; annual totals summed by Oath & Action.
notes: Many applications never become a business that hires anyone, so the count measures plans to start one.
alt: A line of business applications each year from 2005 to 2025 in the United States: about 2.5 million a year through 2013, rising to 3.5 million in 2019, 5.4 million in 2021 and 5.7 million in 2025.
